label: Frilled Lizard
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One independent square Glaze artwork with true transparent background. RASPNEST HEATH, a tangible heathland formed entirely from dry EXCELSIOR WOOD-WOOL sculpture. The reference is our own echidna artwork and is used ONLY to match physical material and lighting; create a wholly different subject. Many irregular thin FLAT brittle wood shavings, tangled ribbons and pointed splinters with longitudinal grain, fibrous fractured tips, subtle curved edges, open inter-strand gaps and compressed dense anatomical bundles. Natural pale honey, russet bark and smoky brown woods, matte and dry, diffuse studio macro lighting, convincing material depth. No smooth solid wooden core, polished carving, fur/plush, string/thread, woven fabric, wire, clay, paper quilling, rolled rosettes or concentric coils. Entire subject fits into central 70% with ample truly transparent space on every side; all tips, claws and foliage comfortably inside the image. No floor or shadow outside subject, panel, backing, atmosphere, frame, text, symbols, clock/battery/calendar or UI. Strong singular silhouette readable at85px. SUBJECT: a complete alert Australian-inspired FRILLED LIZARD standing low on four splayed clawed feet, facing left in three-quarter view, with a broad fully spread circular frill around its small head. The frill is a spectacular fan of thin raw wood slivers with branching strut-like shavings and open little gaps, no solid cloth disc. Long narrow tail curls in a wide S beside the body without touching edges. Keep reptile anatomy recognizable and frill, all limbs and tail whole. No echidna or grass clump.
processing: Whole original uniformly contained within900px on transparent1024square, alpha preserved. No subject crop, recolour or artistic edits.

references.purpose: Own first artwork supplies the physical wood-shaving material and lighting only; new distinct subject.
